# FriskAI raises $3.6M from MaC Venture Capital to watch what AI agents do
- MaC Venture Capital led the round, targeting the healthcare, insurance, and finance sectors.

MaC Venture Capital, which has backed companies including Pipe, Blavity and IronVest, led the round, joined by Wischoff Ventures, NEA partner [Rick Yang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rickcyang) and a group of strategic angel investors.
